implement: legion-worker: the push, pull-request body, proof-on-GitHub-served-bytes, review-thread and handoff rules the implementer follows; dispatch before any Dispatch write. No repository skill exists (no AGENTS.md, no test harness, no deploy surface), so GitHub's served content at an explicit SHA is the production-like surface.
test: legion-worker: references/pr-body.md defines what the tester verifies (drive the surface, read CI, never rerun it) and the tester's handoff; the repository has no test skill and the spec admits no test file.
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md and references/review-threads.md define the review round and its submission at the head; docs-only pull request, so no thermonuclear pair.

findings.finding: The spec has no Acceptance section; every criterion a phase judges is private to the planner.
findings.answer: plan.md §3 publishes C1, C2, C3 and the CI criterion, each with surface, command, expected output and negative control; the same set is in this handoff's acceptance array.

findings.finding: The file's text is unsourced; the precedent drop of the title's /tmp parenthetical has no precedent and the byte count is uncounted.
findings.answer: D2: line 1 is 'LEGSMOKE-846: Pre-merge boot of a deployment's worker pod block' + LF = 64 bytes (measured with printf | wc -c). The drop has precedent: LEGSMOKE-836's title carried '(/tmp/legion-e2e4b.1794117.8tDTo0xD)' (dispatch read) and its merged smoke/LEGSMOKE-836.md:1 drops it.

findings.finding: The apostrophe in deployment's breaks a single-quoted shell literal.
findings.answer: D3: every literal is a double-quoted printf '%s\n' "$L1" argument, L1 set once per shell; plan.md §2 and §3 commands use that form.

findings.finding: A flat 'exactly one line' criterion fails the reviewed arm.
findings.answer: D5 and C3: detector K over the pull request's review comments selects the arm; K=0 requires 64 bytes / 1 line, K=1 requires 64+len(L)+1 bytes / 2 lines.

findings.finding: The second line's text is nowhere in the spec; what if the reviewer's wording differs or the detector misses?
findings.answer: D5: the appended line is the review's fenced quote byte-for-byte (extractor L), never a constant; §4.4 tells the reviewer the exact shape; §6.1: K!=1 when a line was asked, or a missing/multi-line fenced block, stops the implementer, which reports to the architect.

findings.finding: 'Nothing else changes' collides with tracked .legion handoffs; the plan must state a two-level rule.
findings.answer: D6 and C2: mid-run the files list minus .legion/LEGSMOKE-846/ paths is exactly the marker; at the merge head the unfiltered list is exactly the marker and .legion/LEGSMOKE-846 is 404 on main (both measured on PR #706).

findings.finding: The skip-checks trailer cannot suppress Actions here since both workflows trigger unconditionally, so gate must be re-read at the final head.
findings.answer: D8 refutes the premise by measurement: PR #706's trailered handoff commits have actions/runs?head_sha total_count 0 and its code commits 4. The plan still names the gate re-read: CI criterion at the post-retro head, judged by the merger's READY and the daemon's merge.

findings.finding: Retro's removal push moves the head after approval; which SHA do READY and the merge judge, and is that push trailered?
findings.answer: D8/D12 and §4.5: retro's removal is a code push (no trailer), gate runs at it, READY names that SHA with gate success and the reviewer's approval re-established if dismissed.

findings.finding: D10 squash-merge commit-count is an inference; the ruleset constrains no merge method.
findings.answer: D11: post-merge acceptance is the contents API at the merge commit's SHA; the commits?path list is reported, not gated on.

findings.finding: Newness is only true at a pinned SHA; sibling trees may merge concurrently.
findings.answer: D10: planning measured 404 and 0 at main c5f092a1; the implementer re-measures against the main SHA its first commit sits on, records SHA and results, and stops and reports if the path already exists (§6.3).

findings.finding: The post-merge surface is unnamed; must pass even if main advances.
findings.answer: D9/D11 and §4.6: contents API and check-runs at the merge commit's SHA from pulls/N merge_commit_sha, never a moving main.

findings.finding: Child issue LEGSMOKE-847 notices have no written rule for phase workers.
findings.answer: Plan preamble: no criterion depends on LEGSMOKE-847 and a child notice is not the targeted human message that licenses action.

findings.finding: No docs/solutions file should be a Scope criterion, not retro etiquette.
findings.answer: D6 folds it into C2: the repository has no docs/ and the merge-head files list must be exactly the marker; §4.6 also checks contents/docs?ref=<merge sha> is 404.
